caption: Fontana del Tritone, Rome
composition: Bernini travertine Triton fountain on a scallop shell with dolphins · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The tourist stands before the Fontana del Tritone, its muscular Triton rising center-frame atop the great scallop shell, blowing his conch as water arcs around him. Dolphins support the shell below, their jets spraying into the basin, while palazzi close the square on left and right. The 13:00 midday sun is fierce under a deep blue sky, sparkling on the falling water.
